text:
zoe: FYI ap-northeast warm-pool join rate dropped to 0 at 04:10Z; new nodes stuck in BOOTSTRAP for ~20m
michael: looking at bootstrap logs — 2 signals: TCP connect timeouts to keystore-proxy and KMS Decrypt AccessDenied once fallback path is hit
tara: did security roll anything regionally last night?
sec-bot: policy-deploy egress-tighten-2026-04 -> ap-northeast at 2026-04-21T03:45Z by eng-security
michael: that lines up. keystore-proxy LB rotated to new IP addresses during the deploy window and the egress allowlist was not updated -> bootstrap egress blocked
zoe: sample errors from node: ```Apr 21 04:12:11 bootstrap network: dial tcp 203.0.113.47:443: timeout; Apr 21 04:12:12 bootstrap auth: KMS:Decrypt AccessDenied Condition aws:SourceIp != 203.0.113.0/24```
tara: impact: warm-pool down -> on-demand starts. estimated marginal spend if this persists ~ $5.5k/day during business hours
michael: mitigation options: (A) add current LB IPs to allowlist with 30m TTL + audit tag, (B) open outbound by hostname via L7 proxy, (C) rollback egress-tighten. prefer A for speed and minimal change
zoe: agree. request emergency exception from eng-security with scoped TTL and audit marker. also want packet captures on first 10 bootstraps
sec-bot: request logged. emergency-exception approval required; please provide exact IPs, TTL, and audit header to be used
michael: resolved LB ips from keystore-proxy.ap-svc.internal: 203.0.113.47, 203.0.113.48, 2001:db8:beef::47
tara: propose allowlist for those three addresses with TTL=30m and require request header `x-rls-temp: apn-warm-unblock-0421`. revert automation scheduled
sec-bot: emergency exception approved: allowlist IPs 203.0.113.47/48 and 2001:db8:beef::47 for 30m. condition: request header x-rls-temp=apn-warm-unblock-0421. auditors=eng-security. revert job scheduled
michael: applying firewall patch now; snippet pushed to fw-asg repo: ```- name: allow-keystore-temp  sources: [203.0.113.47/32,203.0.113.48/32,2001:db8:beef::47/128]  ttl: 30m  audit_tag: apn-warm-unblock-0421```
zoe: running canary 5 joins, watching `kubectl -n ml get nodes -l pool=ap-northeast-warm` and bootstrap logs
michael: canary 1/5 -> Ready at 7070707092; canary 3/5 completed, pool ramping
tara: security check: CloudTrail shows KMS:Decrypt events with header tag present and source IPs matching allowlist. SIEM shows no anomalous volumes
zoe: good. after stabilization we should: (1) add automation to sync keystore-proxy LB IPs into egress allowlists, (2) make bootstrap set the audit header on keystore calls, (3) add a preflight check during egress rollouts to verify DNS -> allowlist parity
michael: will open infra-PRs for DNS-sync and a small bootstrap change to set `x-rls-temp` when unblocking; also will add a unit test that simulates LB rotation during rollout
tara: schedule a short postmortem and include a decision about preferring hostname/SNI allow over IP allowlists for keystore traffic
infra-bot: incident INC-20260421-apn-keystore-egress created, assignees=eng-ml,eng-security, status=mitigated, followup=postmortem-20260422
zoe: leaving incident open until followups are tracked. thanks for the quick turnround :thumbsup:
